keys: Enter sends, Shift+Enter starts a new line.

empty.title: Ask your documents
empty.text: RagOxide answers questions from the documents in your folders. Every statement carries a number; a click on it shows the passage in the document.
empty.note: If RagOxide finds no matching passage, it says so instead of making something up.

phaseText.pending: Your question goes to the library.
phaseText.waiting: Another question is being answered right now, in another chat or by a connected program. Yours comes next.

searching.first: Looking for matching passages in your documents.
searching.followUp: Rephrases your follow-up question and looks for matching passages in your documents.

starting_model.first: The passages found are already in the evidence and can be read.
starting_model.followUp: For a follow-up question the search itself needs the answer model. The sources come afterwards.

phaseText.reading_sources: “{level}” reads the passages before it writes.
phaseText.writing: The text appears as it is written. The numbers are checked against the sources at the end.

streaming: {level} · running for {time} · The numbers are checked against the sources at the end.

fast.offer: Taking too long? The fast level usually starts within half a minute.

cancelledKept: The text up to here stays saved, with its verified sources.
cancelledEmpty: The answer had not started yet.

again.note: Have the same question answered anew, as a new answer at the bottom of the chat:

none.why: Nothing in your documents answers this question. RagOxide answers only with evidence, so there is no answer here.
none.ingesting: The library is still reading {left} of {total} files. If the answer is in them, ask again afterwards.
none.todo: Phrase the question differently, or check in the library whether the document is included.
none.similarNone: There are no similar passages either.

similarShown.one: 1 similar passage is in the evidence, unverified.
similarShown.other: {count} similar passages are in the evidence, unverified.

levelMenuFoot: Applies to all further questions until you change it.

wait.fast: usually starts within half a minute
wait.balanced: usually starts after about a minute
wait.thorough: starts only after several minutes and is written more slowly than you read

levelState.missing: Not downloaded yet, about {size} GB. Offered when you choose it.
levelState.missingAtLeast: Not downloaded yet, at least {size} GB. Offered when you choose it.
levelState.failed: Download failed. Choose it to try again.
levelState.notOffered: Not available: needs at least 16 GB of memory, this computer has {ram} GB.

help.running: The answer is running. Cancel takes effect at once, also while the model starts.
help.paused: Download of “{level}” paused at {percent} %. Resume it in the level menu.
help.failed: Download of “{level}” failed: {cause}. The parts downloaded stay, a new attempt continues from there. Without internet, the offline package in the settings helps. Until then “{current}” answers.
help.failedStored: Download of “{level}” failed: {cause}. The parts downloaded stay, a new attempt continues from there. Without internet, the offline package in the settings helps.
help.weak: This computer offers only “Fast”: the other levels need at least 16 GB of memory.

price.fast: Fast: the answer usually starts within half a minute.
price.balanced: Balanced: the answer usually starts after about a minute.
price.thorough: Thorough: every question takes several minutes until you change the level.

download.title: Download “{level}” first?
download.size: The answer model for “{level}” is still missing, about {size} GB from the internet.
download.sizeAtLeast: The answer model for “{level}” is still missing, at least {size} GB from the internet.
download.free: The model folder has {free} GB free, enough for it.
download.tooLittle: The model folder has only {free} GB free, too little for {size} GB. Free up space before downloading.
download.background: The download runs in the background and can be paused and resumed in the level menu. Until it is done, “{level}” answers.
download.backgroundNoAnswer: The download runs in the background and can be paused and resumed in the level menu.
download.questionStays: Your question stays in the input.
download.againAfter: Afterwards you can ask the question again.
download.blocked: The model folder has only {free} GB free. {lacking} GB are missing. Free up space, then you can download.

sources.noneNote: The sources of your answer appear here, with number and location.
sources.pendingNote: The sources appear here as soon as the search has found them.
sources.followUpNote: Sources follow after the model has started.
sources.foundNote: Which passages the answer cites is settled only when it is done.
sources.noSourcesNote: There is no passage for this question in your documents.
sources.similarNote: Unverified: the search found these passages; there is no answer to them.
sources.similarNone: The search found no similar passages either.

rename.label: Title of the chat
rename.empty: An empty title cannot be saved. The previous one stays.

history.empty: No chats yet. Your questions appear here, ordered by date.

delete.title: Delete “{title}”?
delete.text: The chat with all its questions and answers is removed for good. This cannot be undone. Your documents stay untouched.

errorKind.not_found: Something it needs no longer exists.
errorKind.unsupported_format: A document has a format RagOxide cannot read.
errorKind.invalid_input: The request could not be made like this.
errorKind.parse: A document could not be read.
errorKind.chunk: A document could not be split into sections.
errorKind.model: A model could not be used.
errorKind.embedding_mismatch: The search no longer matches the documents read. Read the library again.
errorKind.index: The search in your documents failed.
errorKind.model_missing: The answer model of this level is missing.
errorKind.generator: The answer model stopped unexpectedly and starts anew with the next question.
errorKind.store: The chat could not be saved.
errorKind.config: The settings could not be read.
errorKind.io: A file or folder could not be read or written.
